svg.title: Exact expected-loss comparison of SGD learning-rate schedules

cc:Work.dc:title: Exact expected-loss comparison of SGD learning-rate schedules
cc:Work.dc:description: Scalar quadratic with unit noise variance, unit initial second moment, and 100 updates. Exact optimum compared with independently tuned linear, cosine, and constant schedules. All axes are linear, including zooms. Learning rates extend to the unused t=100 budget boundary. No sampled training data.
